outcome.answer: R2LM, introduced in “Bifocal Diffusion Language Models: Asymmetric Bidirectional Context for Parallel Generation,” reports 2.4×–12.9× higher throughput than bidirectional diffusion language models and 1.9×–2.9× speedup over autoregressive baselines in batch serving [1]. It combines causal attention with KV caching and a reverse Mamba sidecar that provides right-side context [1].
